content: LangGraph mature for durable multi-step agent graphs (checkpoints, human-in-loop); heavier abstraction. Claude Agent SDK (code.claude.com docs, TS+Python) provides subagents, MCP tools, permission modes, hooks, production-grade agent loop out of the box. For orchestrator-in-Go: use SDK inside Node runner services rather than LangGraph; LangGraph adds Python dep + graph runtime for marginal gain.
